name: BACH_0364
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (70%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review

Conformal set holds Invasive only, but MUSK disagrees and 4 of 5 neighbors are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 70%, InSitu 30% | Moderate margin; InSitu runner-up |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.93 / 36th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors mostly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical level; concept model leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Typical level; additive term favors invasive, counterintuitive for benign tissue [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical level; fits an in situ alternative [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · High level, but spot check failed (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell density** (regions 2, 6) · context · Higher than 95% of reference images; sampled regions only [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Necrosis (3/20) and normal lobules (0/20) failed spot checks.

## Could be wrong if
- MUSK and most neighbors favor InSitu; the true class may be InSitu.
- Cell measurements cover only regions 2 and 6, not the whole image.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 3, 0**: highest heatmap contribution; look for stromal invasion versus in situ growth.
2. **Regions 2, 9**: check whether atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
3. **Region 10**: strongest infiltrating-stroma area; confirm tumor cells invade stroma.
